name: toast-pos-mcp
description: Public, read-only Toast POS reporting MCP server.

scripts.clean: node --eval "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => Promise.all([rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }), rm('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })]))"
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.check: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:test && npm test && npm run pack:check
scripts.test:discovered: node --eval "import('node:fs').then(({readdirSync})=>{const f=readdirSync('dist-test/test',{recursive:true}).filter(n=>String(n).endsWith('.test.js'));if(f.length===0){console.error('no compiled test files discovered under dist-test/test');process.exit(1);}console.log('discovered '+f.length+' test file(s)');})"
